title: Ruling
description: The shared shape of an operator ruling. Field-for-field the problem-brief ruling, so a ruling moves between a brief and a chorus fallback record without loss. Chorus records normally hold only a ruling_ref to it.

kind.description: Record kind, when the ruling is stored as a file of its own.

id.description: Stable citation handle. R-1, R-2, … Never renumber, never reuse.

created.description: When the ruling was given. Set once.

about.description: The question it answers, phrased the way it would be asked again.

said.description: The answer itself, in the operator's own words where given.

source.description: Where it was given: 'chat, 2026-09-25', 'comment on Q-4', a commit or a document.

status.description: active — still holds. replaced — the operator later said otherwise; replacedBy names the successor.

replacedBy.description: The ruling that took over. Required once status is replaced.

memory.description: A memory file the ruling was also saved to, when it is a general working preference.
